name: Jacobian Factor Omission
definition: In standard Monte Carlo rendering, transformations (UV mapping to surface, surface to camera rays) require accounting for probability density changes via Jacobian determinants. These include UV mapping distortion and a geometry term $\frac{\cos(\theta)}{d^2}$, where $\theta$ is the incident angle to the sampled surface and $d$ is the distance to the camera. This method omits these explicit Jacobian terms.
